#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

HELVETICA_WIDTHS = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 35: 556, 36: 556, 37: 889, 38: 667, 39: 191,
    40: 333, 41: 333, 42: 389, 43: 584, 44: 278, 45: 333, 46: 278, 47: 278,
    48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556, 55: 556,
    56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 60: 584, 61: 584, 62: 584, 63: 556,
    64: 1015, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722, 68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778,
    72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667, 76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778,
    80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667, 84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944,
    88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 91: 278, 92: 278, 93: 278, 94: 469, 95: 556,
    96: 333, 97: 556, 98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278,
    103: 556, 104: 556, 105: 222, 106: 222, 107: 500, 108: 222, 109: 833,
    110: 556, 111: 556, 112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278,
    117: 556, 118: 500, 119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500, 123: 334,
    124: 260, 125: 334, 126: 584,
}


def text_width_pt(text, size):
    return sum(HELVETICA_WIDTHS.get(ord(ch), 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size


def esc_pdf_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(pages_content, mediabox=(612, 792)):
    """Build a minimal valid PDF from raw content streams (bytes per page)."""
    n = len(pages_content)
    font_obj_num = 3 + 2 * n
    body = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}

    def add_object(obj_num, data):
        offsets[obj_num] = len(body)
        body.extend(f"{obj_num} 0 obj\n".encode())
        body.extend(data)
        body.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

    add_object(1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    kids = " ".join(f"{3 + i} 0 R" for i in range(n))
    add_object(2, f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>".encode())

    for i in range(n):
        page_obj_num = 3 + i
        content_obj_num = 3 + n + i
        page_data = (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R "
            f"/MediaBox [0 0 {mediabox[0]} {mediabox[1]}] "
            f"/Contents {content_obj_num} 0 R "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 {font_obj_num} 0 R >> >> >>"
        ).encode()
        add_object(page_obj_num, page_data)
        stream = pages_content[i]
        content_data = (
            f"<< /Length {len(stream)} >>\nstream\n".encode()
            + stream
            + b"\nendstream"
        )
        add_object(content_obj_num, content_data)

    add_object(font_obj_num, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")

    xref_offset = len(body)
    body.extend(f"xref\n0 {font_obj_num + 1}\n".encode())
    body.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for obj_num in range(1, font_obj_num + 1):
        body.extend(f"{offsets[obj_num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    body.extend(
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {font_obj_num + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n".encode()
    )
    return bytes(body)


# --- 1. Build the cover page -------------------------------------------------
W, H = 612, 792
title = "Annual Financial Report"
today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B") + " " + str(today.day) + ", " + str(today.year)

title_size = 30
date_size = 16
title_x = (W - text_width_pt(title, title_size)) / 2.0
date_x = (W - text_width_pt(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
title_y = 470
date_y = 400

cover_stream = "\n".join([
    "BT",
    "/F1 30 Tf",
    "0.15 0.22 0.52 rg",
    f"{title_x:.1f} {title_y} Td",
    f"({esc_pdf_text(title)}) Tj",
    "0 0 0 rg",
    "/F1 16 Tf",
    f"{date_x:.1f} {date_y} Td",
    f"({esc_pdf_text(date_str)}) Tj",
    "0.15 0.22 0.52 RG",
    "0.9 w",
    "72 360 m 540 360 l S",
    "ET",
]).encode("latin-1")

cover_pdf = build_pdf([cover_stream])

# --- 2. Build the sample report body (2 pages) --------------------------------
report_lines1 = [
    "FINANCIAL REPORT",
    "",
    "This sample report was generated because no existing report.pdf was",
    "found in the workspace when the cover-page task was run.",
    "",
    "Section 1: Summary",
    "The organization achieved steady revenue growth during the period.",
    "Operating expenses remained within the approved budget.",
]
report_lines2 = [
    "Section 2: Outlook",
    "Management expects continued growth in the next fiscal year.",
    "Capital expenditures are planned for the second half of the year.",
    "",
    "This concludes the sample body content.",
]

page1_stream = "\n".join(["BT", "/F1 16 Tf"] +
                         [f"72 {700 - i * 22} Td ({esc_pdf_text(l)}) Tj"
                          for i, l in enumerate(report_lines1) if l] +
                         ["ET"]).encode("latin-1")
page2_stream = "\n".join(["BT", "/F1 14 Tf"] +
                         [f"72 {700 - i * 22} Td ({esc_pdf_text(l)}) Tj"
                          for i, l in enumerate(report_lines2) if l] +
                         ["ET"]).encode("latin-1")

body_pdf = build_pdf([page1_stream, page2_stream])

with open("cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cover_pdf)
with open("report_body.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(body_pdf)

# --- 3. Merge: cover page + report body -> report.pdf ------------------------
writer = PdfWriter()
for src in ["cover.pdf", "report_body.pdf"]:
    for page in PdfReader(src).pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

# --- 4. Verify -----------------------------------------------------------------
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print(f"report.pdf created with {len(reader.pages)} page(s):")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    text = (page.extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"  Page {i + 1}: {text}")
